in_hebrew.name: Asquith
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Asquith הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English æscetig, meaning 'discerning' or 'wise'. The name Asquith may have been given to a child who was expected to grow up to be a wise and prudent individual.

in_greek.long_meaning: Asquith είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English æscetig, meaning 'discerning' or 'wise'. The name Asquith may have been given to a child who was expected to grow up to be a wise and prudent individual.

in_latin.name: Asquith
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Ascetic, Discerning
in_latin.long_meaning: Asquith est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English æscetig, meaning 'discerning' or 'wise'. The name Asquith may have been given to a child who was expected to grow up to be a wise and prudent individual.
